scheme_name: Scheme for Meritorious Students to Pursue Higher Secondary Education in the Best Schools of Tamil Nadu
other_conditions: The beneficiary must be a student.
The beneficiary must be a resident of Tamil Nadu.
The beneficiary must belong to Backward Classes (BC), Most Backward Classes (MBC), or Denotified Communities (DNC).
The beneficiary must have secured the highest marks in the 10th public examination.
The beneficiary must be among the top 10 meritorious students from each district.
The beneficiary must be studying in a Government, Government Aided, or Private school.
benefits_summary: Full financial assistance for pursuing higher secondary education in reputed private schools.
